up: Retrieve the exact activity values (including standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, and standard_type) and the canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in the assay identified by CHEMBL1614331. Include all activity records for that assay without filtering on relation type. Join with compound_structures to obtain the canonical SMILES, and only include compounds that have a canonical SMILES entry.
sql: SELECT a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614331';

up: Retrieve all activity records for the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1614331' that have exact measured values. For each activity record, provide the following columns: standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, standard_type (these together constitute the exact activity value), and the canonical SMILES of the tested compound. Only include records where standard_relation is '=' (exact) and where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is not null. The canonical SMILES must be obtained by joining with the compound_structures table on molregno. Return the data without limiting the number of rows. Do not add any other filters or columns beyond those explicitly requested.
sql: SELECT a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614331' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_relation IS NOT NULL;
